name: Gawainn
description: (Tag:tech)(Tag:vehicle)(Tech) Gawainn, a tall Experimental Knightmare perfected by the Black Knights for one or two pilots. It carries Reinforced Armour, Floatation flight systems, 10 finger-mounted slash harkens, and 2 shoulder-mounted devastating Hadron Cannons. Its Ygdrassil Drive replenishes every 24 hours.
